name: vtbl
meaning: MeshPart vtable 0x5743c4 (one slot, the vector deleting dtor 0x40c020): stored by MeshPart_Ctor 0x41a07c and MeshPart_Dtor 0x41a215

name: parentIndex
meaning: index of the parent part; 0xffff (none) from MeshPart_Ctor 0x41a115, the file's u16 from BsFile_Type4_ReadTable14; AnimMesh_Draw reads it to pick the parent's +0x14/+0x18 matrices

name: field_08
meaning: zeroed by MeshPart_Ctor 0x41a11f; no reader in this range

name: vertexCount
meaning: vertices of this part (u16 from the file); zeroed by MeshPart_Ctor 0x41a129

name: matrix
meaning: the part's final matrix = *scaleMatrix * *localMatrix, written by MeshPart_BuildMatrices 0x41a76a; the only one MeshPart_Dtor frees (0x41a21e)

name: localMatrix
meaning: rotation * translation * parent's localMatrix, written by MeshPart_BuildMatrices 0x41a735; children receive it as parentMat

name: scaleMatrix
meaning: SetScale(lerped scale) at 0x41a6ff; children receive it as parentScale (its diagonal scales their offset)

name: offset
meaning: joint offset from the parent, from the file (s16 via Bs_S16ToFloat); scaled by the parent scale diagonal in MeshPart_BuildMatrices 0x41a50f..0x41a53b

name: rot
meaning: current rotation (radians), lerped toward targetRot through the wrap helpers by MeshPart_BlendThenSetTarget 0x41a241
